findings.title: The counsellor-facing ApprovalScreen.tsx has NO input for a rejection reason. The RejectedFactSchema.reason field this unit's audit is built around can only ever be populated by a raw API caller, never by a counsellor using the shipped UI (apps/web/src/components/ApprovalScreen.tsx buildResponse() returns `{key, decision}` for a reject with no `reason`, and there is no textbox/field rendered for a reject decision anywhere in the component). In real usage the reject-reason audit record will always be written with `rejected: [{key}]` and no `reason`, which undercuts the feature's own stated purpose ('records the counsellor's own reason text' / 'this unit's whole point'). Not disclosed as a residual in the manifest.

DemoReadback (apps/web/demo/seed.ts DemoReadback interface + readback()) does not include the `decisions` collection, so the reject-reason audit record cannot be observed through the running app at all (not via /api/demo/readback, not via any UI screen) -- consistent with, and slightly broader than, the manifest's own disclosed residual 2 ('no screen reads it back'). The checker verified the audit record's existence, fencing, idempotency, erasure read-back=0 and export inclusion at the packages/db level instead (own falsifying edits reproduced; see verdict CAPABILITY-COVERAGE).
